title: AE61032: Introduction To Turbulence
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: AE21001
3 - 0 - 0: 3 CreditsNature and origin of
turbulence; Reynolds averaging, Boussinesq eddy viscosity hypothesis, Prandtl s
mixing length theory and von Karman s similarity hypothesis, vorticity
dynamics; Statistical theory of turbulence: isotropic and homogeneous
turbulence, scales of turbulence, turbulence modeling: turbulent boundary
layers, wakes jets and mixing layers, LES and DNS, experimental methods in
turbulence, turbulent flow in pipes.
